name: RANUNCULUS SCELERATUS
key_symptoms: Integument sensitive. Bruised pain and weakness in the chest every evening. Sore burning behind xiphoid cartilage.
Gnawing in one spot left of vertex. Frightful dreams about corpses, serpents, battles, etc. Fluent coryza, with sneezing and burning micturition.
Boring pain. Sudden burning sticking in right toe. Corns, with burning and soreness, especially when feet hang down. Gout in fingers and toes.

gi_symptoms: Sensation of a plug behind umbilicus. Pain over region of liver, with sensation as if diarrhśa would set it. Pressure as of a plug behind right false ribs; worse, deep inspiration.
